scheme_name: Prosthetic Aid and Appliances for Person with Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must have a disability of 40% or more.
Employment-oriented tools will not be provided to individuals under the age of 16.
Equipment (both employment-oriented and disability‑relieving) can be obtained only once in a period of 5 years.
benefits_summary: Provides prosthetic aids and appliances such as artificial limbs, crutches, wheelchairs, hearing aids, musical instruments and self‑employment tools up to ₹20,000 for persons with a disability of 40% or more.
